KC Critical Mass

Kansas City, MO · Westport · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

KC Critical Mass is a social group ride in Kansas City, MO. It rolls last Friday of the month at 7:00 pm from Sunfresh in Westport, back lot off 40th & Pennsylvania. Pace: slowest rider sets the pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slowest rider sets the pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the KC Critical Mass group ride

A monthly parade-style ride through Kansas City on the last Friday. No set route, no leaders, the slowest rider sets the pace and the group masses up when it spreads out. News and the ride calendar live on the Facebook group.
